text: Consider the following matrices: $$ A = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} 3 \amp 0 \amp -1 \amp 1 \\ 1 \amp -1 \amp 3 \amp 7 \\ 3 \amp -2 \amp 1 \amp 5 \\ -1 \amp 2 \amp 2 \amp 3 \\ \end{array}\right],~~~ B = \left[\begin{array}{rrrr} 3 \amp 0 \amp -1 \amp 4 \\ 1 \amp -1 \amp 3 \amp -1 \\ 3 \amp -2 \amp 1 \amp 3 \\ -1 \amp 2 \amp 2 \amp 1 \\ \end{array}\right] $$ . Do the columns of $A$ span $\real^4$? Do the columns of $B$ span $\real^4$?
